# CodeBuild advanced build execution

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Docker workers, build history, CloudWatch logs, S3 source/artifacts and buildspec 0.2 are implemented. Extend the remaining runtime features separately.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] RetryBuild and automatic retry policies
- [ ] Batch builds
- [ ] Git source checkout and authentication
- [ ] Webhooks, report groups and report generation
- [ ] Cache, managed runtime installation and secondary sources/artifacts
- [ ] Service-role credentials, KMS encryption and S3 logs

## Integration decisions

Use the implemented worker lifecycle and transactional build records. See the [CodeBuild guide](../../guides/codebuild-records.md) for the delivered subset and explicit execution boundaries.
